title: 2017-2019 Escape / Fusion 1.5L EcoBoost: coolant into the cylinders, low coolant, white smoke, misfire
summary: Ford Customer Satisfaction Programs 19B37 (PCM reprogram) and 21N12 (one-time short block replacement): coolant can get into a cylinder bore, causing coolant loss, white exhaust smoke and misfire codes. The dealer letter includes the pressure test and borescope check that confirm it.

specs.name: Cooling system pressure test
specs.value: 138 kPa (20 psi), engine at operating temperature, held 2 hours

specs.name: Fails the pressure test
specs.value: Drop of more than 27.57 kPa (4 psi) in 2 hours

specs.name: 21N12 coverage
specs.value: One-time short block replacement, 7 years or 84,000 miles from warranty start; vehicles already past that were covered through November 30, 2022

specs.name: Prerequisite
specs.value: Program 19B37 (PCM reprogram) must be done before 21N12 applies

specs.name: Fusion covered
specs.value: 2017 Flat Rock (built October 1-16, 2015); 2017-2019 Hermosillo (built October 6, 2015 through June 10, 2019)

steps.text: Check the PCM for P0300-P0304, P0316, P0217, P1285 and/or P1299. None of them means the program doesn't apply; diagnose normally.
At operating temperature, pressurize the cooling system to 138 kPa (20 psi) for 2 hours and test the coolant for combustion gases (Workshop Manual section 303-03A).
Combustion gases in the coolant: go straight to short block replacement. Pressure drop over 27.57 kPa (4 psi) with no gases: pull the spark plugs.
With the plugs out, borescope the cylinders for coolant. No coolant in any cylinder means the program doesn't apply.
Confirmed: remove the engine and replace the short block (WSM section 303-01). Warn the owner the exhaust may smell for a while as leftover coolant burns off.

body:
Owners who paid for a short block or head gasket for coolant intrusion before the owner letter could be refunded until November 30, 2022. Coverage transfers to later owners, and title-branded and salvage vehicles are eligible.

TSB 22-2322 on the same condition was also opened, but its PDF on NHTSA uses a font encoding that doesn't extract as text, so only the program letter is cited here.

sources.title: Customer Satisfaction Program 21N12: Certain 2017-2019 Fusion and Escape with 1.5L GTDI, short block replacement after coolant intrusion (dealer letter, attachments and owner letter)
sources.citation: Program terms and vehicles p. 1; labor Attachment II; service procedure Attachment III; NHTSA ID 10213732
